scope.protocol: Q1-E1 UnweightedFedAvg vs published FedAvg, FedProx, FedTrimmedAvg (+ best rival)
primary_metrics: AUC = mean macro-F1 over 30 FL rounds
scope.iid_resolution: Non-IID only (α∈{1.0,0.5,0.1}). No UW-IID runs. Published FA/Prox/FT IID rows in Corrected_Results_Packet are not UW comparators and must not be pooled into UW margins. Full grid including IID requires 12 UW-IID cells + amendment before claim.

provenance.uw: local match_notebook q1_e1_*_raw.csv + history_{cic|nbaiot}_* UnweightedFedAvg files
provenance.fa_prox_ft: published all_runs_raw.csv + history_* (cross-hardware except local FA gates)
provenance.best_rival_definition: For each endpoint separately, best_rival = argmax among {FedAvg, FedProx, FedTrimmedAvg} on that endpoint
provenance.n_baIoT_filter: UnweightedFedAvg + match_notebook + complete Final_Acc/Final_F1/AUC; exclude incomplete legacy FedAvg row

canonical_packet_input_histories.note: Canonical packet-input histories: 36 UW + 108 published (FA/Prox/FT) = 144 total (published = 36 UW cells × 3 arms). Prefer this count over all history files on disk.

f3_policy.reporting: descriptive means, margins (pp), labelled sign counts only; no UW Welch/paired/Holm/BH/TOST and no exploratory UW p-values under this freeze; any UW inference requires a separate dated amendment that freezes the family first
f3_policy.c8: frozen 0/36 vs 7/72; do not fold UW cells into that table

notes: CIC CNN α=1.0 UW−FT seed-mean Final F1 is a small observed difference (-0.0817 pp), AUC (-0.1701 pp); not an equivalence claim at n=3.
Margins in pp = 100 × (UW − baseline) on the probability scale [0,1].
Best_Acc / Best_F1 for UW are secondary diagnostics stored in the seed-level CSV (uw_Best_Acc, uw_Best_F1), recomputed from 30-round histories.
Contract §4 margins: always report vs FedAvg and vs best_rival_* columns (best rival may be FedProx).
